<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Town Planning Authority" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="coord" name="Coordination Unit">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>draft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>addDates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>recheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="support" name="Support Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>checkDates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>suggest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="members" name="Committee Member">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>checkDiaries</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>advise</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="November arrives" />
    <bpmn:task id="draft" name="Draft a schedule of meetings for the next calendar year" />
    <bpmn:task id="addDates" name="Add draft dates to all calendars" />
    <bpmn:task id="checkDates" name="Check the dates" />
    <bpmn:task id="suggest" name="Suggest modifications" />
    <bpmn:task id="recheck" name="Recheck all dates and look for potential conflicts" />
    <bpmn:task id="send" name="Send the final schedule of meeting dates by email" />
    <bpmn:task id="checkDiaries" name="Check diaries" />
    <bpmn:task id="advise" name="Advise the Coordination Unit of any conflicts" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Conflicts advised" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="draft" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="draft" targetRef="addDates" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="addDates" targetRef="checkDates" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="checkDates" targetRef="suggest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="suggest" targetRef="recheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="recheck" targetRef="send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="send" targetRef="checkDiaries" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="checkDiaries" targetRef="advise" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="advise" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
